$comment: The pitch catalog (ticket E0130, owner quiz 2026-11-10): the approved wording of the product story, one string per touchpoint, in the author languages. House-style repairs applied to the owner's catalog of 2026-11-09 (plain hyphen for the em dash, the mangled uk title 'Конвертер тарідер' repaired to 'конвертер і ридер'); the strings were accepted as the single copy source with no separate copy pass. The titles drop the template's 'for Windows' - the site's SEO gate caps a title at 60 characters, and the platform stands in the meta description and the operatingSystem facts. tests/site_pitch_test.go holds the landing surfaces against this file. The hub-card string is catalogued here as the approved wording but is applied on the hub (sza.od.ua) by the hub's own ticket - it is never edited here.

touchpoints.title: The product title on the landing head (<title>, og:title, twitter:title) and the title the page's own strings rewrite it to, on index.html and the ru and uk landings.
touchpoints.short_pitch: The one-sentence pitch a store summary or a README lead opens with.
touchpoints.hub_card_description: The SZA hub card's product description (applied on the hub, not here).
touchpoints.hero_tagline: The landing hero tagline under the h1; its first sentence is the h1 itself.

en.title: doc-html-translate - document converter and reader
en.short_pitch: Turn books and documents into local HTML pages for instant reading and browser translation.
en.hub_card_description: Convert EPUB, PDF, MOBI, FB2, comics and scanned images into clean local HTML. Read, search and translate in your browser - no API keys required. Desktop GUI, CLI and a Chromium extension.
en.hero_tagline: Turn any book, document or comic into a local web page. Read it, search it and translate it with your browser's native engine - free, private, no keys required.
